name: surface-tension
description: UI components whose shapes merge, neck and separate like a liquid — one SVG filter under ordinary DOM. No WebGL, no canvas, no dependencies.

scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run build:types && npm run build:site
scripts.build:lib: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --external:react --external:react-dom --target=es2019 && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs --external:react --external:react-dom --target=es2019 && node scripts/extract-tokens.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build:lib && npm run build:types
